reviews.pros: This company can give you everything you want in your life. I have seen many people in my company living a very good life because of my company. Everything is neatly driven and you can work on your assigned work and leave for the day. You will get 10l medical insurance for your family (meaning your wife, children only, not parents - which I don't like). You will get home pickup and home drop with ac cabs. They will provide a meal card. You will be paid much better than you think when you do overtime. They will provide housing loan interest subsidies for eligible people. You get 12 CL, 12 EL, 11 ML in total, which is best compared to any other company. In the cafeteria, you will get everything from Boost, Horlicks, cool drinks. They really care about their employees.
reviews.cons: Even though there are many good things about the company, salaries have been stagnant for many years. People with higher tenures draw a lower salary. Problem is not enough higher role considering huge amount of people. I really like this company a lot for many reasons, but just one thing I want management to work on is providing better salaries for high tenured people. Commodity prices are inflated. Please increase the salary too.
